framing: Everyone's building yet another sleek web dashboard for their YC-roast tool. The unfashionable truth: indie hackers who actually ship live in the terminal — so WhyC is a curl-able CLI that pipes a job-posting URL in and emails you back a Cloud Run link, with the full self-improvement loop streamed as plaintext to stdout. No SPA. No login. No Tailwind.
target_persona: The 4am-curl indie hacker who already has tmux open — judges YC by github commit graphs, runs `npm` only because they have to, would absolutely paste a YC job URL into a terminal and forget about it until an email arrives.
opus_4_7_capability: Long-horizon agent reasoning across the Phoenix MCP self-improvement loop — Gemini ADK plans which flows are under-spec from trace data, regenerates only those, and narrates each iteration as terminal-grade structured logs (no JSON pretty-printing, no spinners, just timestamped lines a tail-follower can grep).
mvp_scope: One-shot CLI: paste YC job URL → stream agent trace to stdout for ~10min → first deploy URL prints inline with spec-fit % → background loop continues, sends a final email when converged. Demo shows curl invocation on a synthetic JD and the email arriving with a working preview link. | surface: Terminal (CLI + curl) with email delivery — `curl whyc.sh -d url=...` returns a streaming SSE log of the agent loop; final Cloud Run URL is delivered by plaintext email when spec-fit converges. No web UI for WhyC itself.
one_liner_pitch: While YC ships React dashboards, we ship a curl one-liner. WhyC: pipe a job URL in, get a working Cloud Run preview in your inbox.
spec_alignment_notes: spec primary_surface=web/hybrid → I deliberately reframed to terminal+email per persona's unfashionable-choice bias (the WhyC product itself is CLI; the *generated preview* is still Next.js on Cloud Run as the spec mandates — stack constraint preserved). target_persona=indie hacker → kept verbatim but sharpened to the terminal-native subset. killer_feature self-improvement loop + hybrid cadence → preserved exactly: ~10min visible streaming, hours-long background convergence, email is the asyn...
